name: id
business_description: Unique row identifier for this booking.

name: created_at
business_description: Timestamp when the record was created.

name: created_by
business_description: User who created the record.

name: modified_at
business_description: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

name: modified_by
business_description: User who last modified the record.

name: status
business_description: Lifecycle status of the booking.

name: applicable_subsidy
business_description: Subsidy amount applicable to this booking.

name: booking_amount
business_description: Amount booked for this transaction.

name: booking_date
business_description: Date on which the booking was made.

name: bookings_id
business_description: Reference to the parent booking record.

name: bookings_status
business_description: Status of the booking in the booking workflow.

name: payment_mode
business_description: Mode of payment used for the booking.

name: transaction_id
business_description: Identifier of the payment transaction for the booking.

name: waiting_no
business_description: Waiting number assigned to the booking in the queue.

name: crop_noncrop_name_id
business_description: Identifier of the crop or non-crop item booked.

name: departmental_scheme_id
business_description: Identifier of the departmental scheme under which the booking was made.

name: online_booking_details_id
business_description: Reference to the detail row of the online booking.

name: online_booking_id
business_description: Reference to the online booking this row belongs to.

name: variety_id
business_description: Identifier of the crop variety booked.

name: payment_term
business_description: Payment term agreed for the booking.

name: grant_id
business_description: Identifier of the grant linked to this booking.

name: booking_person
business_description: Person count the booking was made for; it may instead be a person identifier, which the name alone does not settle.

name: sub_assistance_id
business_description: Identifier of the subsidy assistance component linked to the booking.

name: payment_status
business_description: Payment status of the booking.

name: document_upload_validity
business_description: Validity period of the uploaded document, in days.

name: financial_year_id
business_description: Identifier of the financial year the booking belongs to.

name: winning_date
business_description: Date on which the booking won allocation in the draw.

name: cancel_date
business_description: Date on which the booking was cancelled.

name: sequence_no
business_description: Sequence number of the booking in processing order.

name: booking_level
business_description: Level at which the booking is made, for example state, district or block.

name: is_scheme_validation_available
business_description: Whether scheme validation is available for this booking.

name: block_name
business_description: Name of the administrative block.

name: district_name
business_description: Name of the district.

name: way_of_booking
business_description: Channel through which the booking was made.

name: block_id
business_description: Identifier of the administrative block.

name: district_id
business_description: Identifier of the district.

name: village_id
business_description: Identifier of the village.

name: temp_column
business_description: Temporary working column; no documented purpose.

name: repayment_date
business_description: Date on which the repayment fell due.

name: repayment_amount
business_description: Amount to be repaid for this booking.

name: repayment_mode
business_description: Mode of repayment used.

name: repayment_transaction_id
business_description: Identifier of the repayment transaction.

name: old_grant_id
business_description: Previous grant identifier retained for migration reference.

name: old_online_booking_details_id
business_description: Previous detail-row identifier retained for migration reference.

name: old_online_booking_id
business_description: Previous online booking identifier retained for migration reference.

name: old83_grant_id
business_description: Grant identifier carried over from the previous system; the "83" prefix is not explained by the field name.

name: old83_online_booking_id
business_description: Online booking identifier carried over from the previous system.

name: old83_online_booking_details_id
business_description: Detail-row identifier carried over from the previous system.

name: revert83to11
business_description: Flag marking a record reverted between system versions; the exact meaning is not stated by the field name.

name: updatewating_status
business_description: Updated waiting-list status of the booking; the field name appears to be a typo of update_waiting_status.

name: old_wating_no
business_description: Previous waiting number retained from the earlier system; the field name appears to be a typo of old_waiting_no.

name: old_bookings_status
business_description: Previous booking status retained from the earlier system.

name: cancel_booking_flag
business_description: Whether the booking has been cancelled.

name: promote_booking_flag
business_description: Whether the booking was promoted off the waiting list.

name: isp_mandal_code
business_description: Mandal (tehsil) code of the ISP office handling the booking.
